name: Table
description: A data table: sortable columns, row selection, row actions, and resizable, sticky columns.

aria-label.description: Names the table when no visible heading does.

aria-labelledby.description: Ids of the elements that name the table, such as the heading above it.

columns.description: Columns in display order; a column without a unique string `id`, or a group or separator, is dropped with a report.

rows.description: Row data, one object per row; a row that is not an object, or repeats a key, is dropped.

rowKey.description: Row key: a row field name or a function of the row, `id` by default. A row whose key is not text is keyed `#<position in rows>`.

sort.description: Controlled order of the rows: a sortable or any other column and a direction; `null` keeps the order of `rows`.

defaultSort.description: Order of the rows on mount (uncontrolled); read once.

selectedRows.description: Keys of the selected rows (controlled); keys without a row are kept and not shown.

defaultSelectedRows.description: Keys of the rows selected on mount (uncontrolled); read once.

selectable.description: Adds a leading checkbox column: one checkbox per row and a select-all checkbox in the header.

rowNumbers.description: Adds a leading column, headed by `labels.rowNumber`, that numbers the rows 1, 2, 3 in the order shown.

stickyHeader.description: Keeps the header row at the top of the nearest scrolling container.

showDividers.description: Draws a line under the header and under every row.

stickyLastColumn.description: Keeps the last column at the inline end of the nearest scrolling container while rows scroll sideways.

resizable.description: Adds a handle to each header cell that resizes its column by pointer or arrow keys; a resize fixes every column, so the table grows or shrinks. Turning it off restores the columns.

activeRow.description: Key of the row marked as the current one (`aria-current`), such as the row open in a detail view.

membrane.description: Outer membrane spacing around the table.

variant.description: `tile` shows each row as one rounded surface, under the pointer and when selected or current, with its content inset; `plain` keeps full-width rows.

labels.description: Names and text of the table's own controls; the table takes a native aria-label or aria-labelledby.

rows.name: A very long row name to test truncation

behavior.stateModel: sort/defaultSort/onSortChange and selectedRows/defaultSelectedRows/onSelectedRowsChange; both work uncontrolled. Selected keys without a row are kept and not shown.
behavior.sorting: A sortable header cycles ascending, descending, then the order of rows. Values compare by number, date or text with numeric runs; empty values go last.
behavior.rowActivation: With onRowClick rows form one tab stop; clicks on controls inside a row and on the selection cell do not activate it.
behavior.resizing: The first resize fixes every column at its rendered width, so a resize changes only its own column and the table grows or shrinks. A column header is named by its label, not by its resize handle. A resize stops at minWidth (48 px without one); onColumnResize reports the rendered width when the drag ends or per key press.
behavior.layout: A column without width sizes to its content and wraps its text; content that cannot wrap (an email, a URL) widens the table, so give it truncate or width, or let the container scroll. A column with width keeps it, its content wrapping inside. truncate keeps text and elements on one line with an ellipsis. In a full-width table the extra room goes to the columns without width. A width that is not a length of 0 or more is reported and left out.
behavior.cellValues: Text and numbers show as text; a boolean or a date needs render, else the cell is empty and reported.

Enter.condition: sortable header button sorts; a focused row calls onRowClick

Space.condition: sortable header button sorts; a row checkbox toggles its row

Home.condition: row: onRowClick; resize handle: minWidth, or 48 px

ArrowRight.condition: resize handle: 10 px wider in LTR, narrower in RTL

ArrowLeft.condition: resize handle: 10 px narrower in LTR, wider in RTL

aria.label: Native aria-label or aria-labelledby names the table.
notes: Sortable headers are native buttons inside columnheader cells with aria-sort.
Row checkboxes are named by labels.selectRow, {name} being the row value in the first column; the current row has aria-current.

Resize handles are focusable separators named by labels.resizeColumn ({name}: the header text), with aria-valuenow in px and aria-valuetext from labels.columnWidth; they render after mount, once the width is known.
Table cell/header text is rendered through Text wrappers to keep typography centralized.

Row states tint cells with --uf-color-hover-bg (selected; the pointer over a clickable row or any tile row) and --uf-color-active-bg (current row, which the pointer never overrides); sticky cells sit on --uf-color-bg.
